fullDescription: An industrial-grade diagnostic interface featuring a high-contrast layout, dense data entry panels, and technical visual overlays. Suitable for manufacturing dashboards, enterprise asset management, fintech telemetry, and IoT monitoring systems. Characterized by 'Satoshi' typography, #005BC5 primary blue accents, and 40px rounded containers.
prompt:
## Resumo
A professional industrial diagnostic dashboard with a split-screen layout (7:12 ratio) optimized for rapid data entry and visual reference. It uses a clean light-gray background (#F8FAFC) with bold, uppercase typography and high-precision input groups.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system using the 'Satoshi' font family (Weights: 400, 700, 900). Background color: #F8FAFC. Primary Action Color: #005BC5. Text Colors: Primary #0F172A (Slate 950), Secondary #64748B (Slate 500). Container Radius: 40px for large modules, 16px for input fields and buttons. Buttons should have a strong shadow: shadow-[0_10px_30px_-5px_rgba(0,91,197,0.3)]. Input fields should be borderless with a light shadow and a 2px blue ring focus state. Section headers should use 10px uppercase bold text with 0.1em-0.2em letter spacing. Use Iconify Lucide icons in Slate-400 for technical metadata.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header Section
Design a header with a large uppercase font-black title (text-4xl to 6xl) using 'industrial-heading' letter-spacing (-0.02em). Below it, place a descriptive paragraph (max-w-xl) in text-lg Slate-500. The layout should be flexible, moving from stacked on mobile to side-by-side with an optional right-aligned element on desktop.

### Diagnostic Input Panel
Create a container with bg-slate-50/50 and a 40px border radius. Inside, organize a 3-column grid (on tablet/desktop) of parameter groups. Each group starts with a blue uppercase label (10px font-black, tracking-widest) and a light blue bottom border. Below the group header, place vertical stacks of input blocks. Each input block consists of a 10px bold uppercase label (Slate-400) and a large, high-radius (16px) white input field with font-bold text.

### Action Button Group
Position a horizontal button group below the inputs. The primary button should be #005BC5 with white uppercase bold text, 20px padding (py-5), and 40px horizontal padding (px-10). The secondary button should be bg-slate-100/50 with slate-500 text and a subtle border. Both buttons must have active:scale-95 transitions.

### Visual Reference Overlay
Implement a 5-column tall container with overflow-hidden and 40px radius. Use a grayscale-filtered image with brightness-95. On hover, the image should scale to 1.05 over 700ms. Apply a bottom-to-top gradient overlay (slate-900/80 to transparent). At the bottom-left, place a blue accent line (32px width) next to a technical visual reference label, followed by a large uppercase font-black title for the asset name.

### Technical Footer
Construct a footer with a top border (slate-200). Include a left-aligned group of technical chips (CPU, Storage) using Lucide icons and 10px font-bold uppercase text. Include a right-aligned reference ID string (e.g., 'Ref: DIA-XXXX') in light slate-300.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### High-Density Input Group — Stacked data entry fields with semantic grouping
Each input field is an 80px high container with rounded-2xl corners, no border, and a subtle drop shadow. Labels are positioned exactly 6px above the input with 10px font-size and tracking-wider. Use :focus-within to apply a 2px blue glow to the container.

### Industrial Visual Card — Image-based asset identifier with data overlay
The card uses an absolute-positioned gradient overlay starting from bottom (80% opacity) to 40% height. Typography inside uses tracking-tight for the main asset title and tracking-[0.2em] for the 'VISUAL REFERENCE' category tag.

## Notas Especiais
MUST maintain the 40px border-radius on main containers for the specific 'soft industrial' look. DO NOT use standard border colors; rely on subtle shadows and focus rings for field definition. ALL labels except body copy must be uppercase with tracking-wider or tracking-widest.
